name: merani
description: A second code review for Codex, with a record of what was checked.

interface.shortDescription: A second review, with a record
interface.longDescription: Merani asks another reviewer to read a fixed copy of your code. Codex checks the findings and records its decisions, then a fresh review checks the final changes. Later edits invalidate the result. Reviews use your provider allowance and can still miss bugs.
defaultPrompt: Review my uncommitted changes and verify the findings.
Review this branch before I merge it.
